import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Income distribution by education level
income_edu_ax = axes[0, 0]
edu_order = ['Basic', '2n Cycle', 'Graduation', 'Master', 'PhD']
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='Education', y='Income', order=edu_order, ax=income_edu_ax)
income_edu_ax.set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
income_edu_ax.set_xlabel('Education Level', fontsize=12)
income_edu_ax.set_ylabel('Income ($)', fontsize=12)
income_edu_ax.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Spending categories comparison
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_means = df[spending_cols].mean()
spending_ax = axes[0, 1]
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(spending_cols)))
bars = spending_ax.bar(range(len(spending_cols)), spending_means.values, color=colors)
spending_ax.set_title('Average Spending by Product Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
spending_ax.set_xlabel('Product Category', fontsize=12)
spending_ax.set_ylabel('Average Amount Spent ($)', fontsize=12)
spending_ax.set_xticks(range(len(spending_cols)))
spending_ax.set_xticklabels(['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold'], rotation=45)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    spending_ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 5,
                    f'{height:.0f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 3. Purchase channels comparison
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases', 'NumDealsPurchases']
purchase_means = df[purchase_cols].mean()
purchase_ax = axes[1, 0]
x_pos = np.arange(len(purchase_cols))
purchase_ax.bar(x_pos, purchase_means.values, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1', '#96CEB4'])
purchase_ax.set_title('Average Number of Purchases by Channel', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
purchase_ax.set_xlabel('Purchase Channel', fontsize=12)
purchase_ax.set_ylabel('Average Number of Purchases', fontsize=12)
purchase_ax.set_xticks(x_pos)
purchase_ax.set_xticklabels(['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store', 'Deals'], rotation=0)
for i, v in enumerate(purchase_means.values):
    purchase_ax.text(i, v + 0.1, f'{v:.1f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 4. Customer demographics heatmap
demo_ax = axes[1, 1]
# Create age from Year_Birth
df['Age'] = 2023 - df['Year_Birth']
# Create total children
df['Total_Children'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
# Create total spending
df['Total_Spending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)

# Prepare data for heatmap
heatmap_data = pd.DataFrame({
    'Age Group': pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[0, 30, 40, 50, 60, 100], labels=['<30', '30-40', '40-50', '50-60', '60+']),
    'Income Group': pd.cut(df['Income'], bins=[0, 30000, 50000, 70000, 100000, 1000000], 
                          labels=['<30k', '30-50k', '50-70k', '70-100k', '100k+']),
    'Children': pd.cut(df['Total_Children'], bins=[-1, 0, 1, 2, 5], labels=['0', '1', '2', '3+'])
})

# Create cross-tabulation
heatmap_table = pd.crosstab(heatmap_data['Age Group'], heatmap_data['Income Group'])
sns.heatmap(heatmap_table, annot=True, fmt='d', cmap='YlOrRd', ax=demo_ax, cbar_kws={'label': 'Number of Customers'})
demo_ax.set_title('Customer Distribution: Age vs Income Groups', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
demo_ax.set_xlabel('Income Group', fontsize=12)
demo_ax.set_ylabel('Age Group', fontsize=12)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
